protocol.previous_actuals_status: These dates occur in archived RT-prior date lists, not prior actual-label scoring/source joins in V5. Existing public forecasts are allowed received inputs; no confirmation actuals are opened before model and envelopes are frozen.
protocol.new_model: outgoing route prior mean + beta*incoming route-centered residual; scale sigma0+sigma1*abs(incoming residual), df fixed3. beta in[0,1], sigma0>=1second, sigma1>=0; three deterministic training-only starts, minimum date-balanced negative log likelihood.
protocol.interval_target: For each date take max across present groups of empirical ceil(.9*n)-th standardized central90 nonconformity. Largest of9 date scores (clipped below at0) is one common envelope factor. Under exchangeable date blocks, joint event: every present observable group has>=90% endpoint coverage on the next date, probability>=90%. No arbitrary individual/date-conditional guarantee.
protocol.interval_standardization: Half the uncalibrated central90 interval width; interval only, does not alter CDF/boarding probability.
protocol.menu: Primary timetable-selected different-trip pairs +/-300seconds around planned incoming arrival+GTFS transfer. Actual-current menu secondary. Unknown outgoing status remains selected/censored.
protocol.freeze: No new date, group boundary, degrees of freedom, start count or model parameter is selected by development or confirmation scores. First candidate is completed and all results retained.
protocol.joint_interface: Finite-chain departure marginal replacement by likelihood-ratio emission; clock means, sampling and conditional continuation must use the resulting same joint law. No scalar failure probability swap.

interpretation: Three independent actual-label date blocks after frozen model/group/envelopes. Historical public RT forecasts from these dates existed but did not fit this candidate. CDF probabilities are raw laws; date-group envelopes modify intervals only.
